description: This file defines the public API for managing flash memory partitions and areas in Zephyr OS, including structures, function prototypes, macros, and constants related to flash map operations.

methods.name: flash_area_open
methods.description: Retrieves a flash_area structure for a given partition ID.

methods.name: flash_area_read
methods.description: Reads data from a flash area.

methods.name: flash_area_write
methods.description: Writes data to a flash area.

methods.name: flash_area_erase
methods.description: Erases a range within a flash area.

methods.name: flash_area_get_sectors
methods.description: Retrieves sector information within a flash area.

methods.name: flash_area_has_driver
methods.description: Checks if a flash area has a supporting driver.

methods.name: flash_area_get_device
methods.description: Gets the device driver associated with a flash area.

methods.name: flash_area_label
methods.description: Returns the label of a flash area if defined.

methods.name: flash_area_erased_val
methods.description: Returns the byte value of erased flash memory.
